sources.wikimedia_commons: per-file licence from Commons extmetadata; CC0 / public domain / CC BY / CC BY-SA approved when author + licence URL are stated
sources.provider_artwork: team crests and player media from a provider (ESPN) ONLY when tied to the entity by an exact provider id from our canonical crosswalk and taken from that provider's own API payload (never a guessed URL); displayed under the owner identification policy, never labelled free-licensed

player_identity: Wikidata item via exact ESPN FC player id (P3681); birth date must not contradict
team_identity: Wikidata club via roster proof (>=60% and >=5 id-matched players share the current club, runner-up <=30%, unique)
crest_trademark_note: Free-licensed Commons crests are approved and used only to identify the club.

owner_identification.rule: identity proven by an exact id + current crest/photo identified + owner approval = eligible for rendering. This is an internal product decision, not a licence: provenance (provider, source URL, retrieved_at, copyright/licence text as known, trademark status, this policy version) is stored truthfully and the asset is never described as free, public domain or licensed.
priority: official club/league asset with deterministic identity
provider artwork tied to an exact provider team/athlete id
